TRACE_ASSERTIONS.ASSERTION: MCP suggest_contract emits # for Python, -- for SQL, and one canonical MODULE_ID for comma-separated input through the focused server_contract_tools helper.
MCP verify_project and review_code accept lite, balanced, and strict profile arguments.
MCP analyze_logs reads a structured LOG file and returns an XML LogAnalysisReport.
MCP extract_belief_state writes a validated docs/belief-states artifact.
MCP generate_requirements writes a validated docs/requirements.xml RequirementsAnalysis artifact.
MCP generate_technology writes a validated docs/technology.xml Technology artifact.
MCP generate_development_plan writes a validated docs/development-plan.xml DevelopmentPlan artifact with DataFlows and GenerationOrder.
MCP mental_test_run writes docs/mental-tests trace output and returns a MentalTestRun report.
MCP traceability_report writes docs/traceability-index.xml and returns a scoped TraceabilityReport.
MCP run_test_guide writes docs/tests result summaries and returns a tester-agent run report.
MCP submit_test_report highlights LOG evidence refs for developer-agent handoff.
MCP self_heal validates run_id, executes the bounded self-heal runtime, and returns a JSON SelfHealResult.
MCP diagnose_failure returns EnhancedFixResult JSON from tester-agent failure evidence.
MCP repair_contract defaults to dry_run and returns preview evidence without writing source content.
MCP token_savings reports command, adapter, and recent session economics from M-TRACKING.
MCP check_budget reports current session budget state and optional estimated-token affordability from M-TRACKING.
MCP verify_project, review_code, project_status, analyze_logs, mental_test_run, traceability_report, token_savings, and refresh_project return shared response economy metadata.
